poseRig.reviewStatus: Estimated display rig, not anatomically validated

arm.method: Humeral head sphere fit to medial half of proximal 18% along PCA axis; approximate elbow pivot at distal 12% vertex centroid; wrist midpoint of lunate/scaphoid vertex centroids. Elbow axis is estimated from upper-arm and forearm directions, not epicondylar landmarks.

shoulderGirdle.method: Estimated sternoclavicular pivot at medial 10% vertex centroid; lateral 10% centroid defines elevation. Clavicle and scapula move together to retain their existing relationship. 10° is a display pose target, not a clinical norm; scapulothoracic glide is not modeled.

leg.method: Hip sphere fit to medial 45% of proximal 8% femoral cap; knee at distal 12% femoral vertex centroid; ankle at superior quartile talus centroid. Two-link leg solve preserves segment lengths; patella follows femur, not a modeled patellar tracking mechanism.
